2226-2499-2950.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-2950.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying its mana cost.
When Aven Surveyor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

602-4691-5436.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4691-5436.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability, giving Witch-king of Angmar indestructible until end of turn and tapping it
Repeat

1339-1832-4050-6794.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6794.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1477-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 1.

851-4365-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-4365-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.

413-6972-7231.description:

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it, Blasting Station and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a creature in step 4, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic token's trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-6797-6909.description:

When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.

Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
